Notices

Diagnostics from data collection and costing. Displayed as visible text, not tooltip metadata.

  • lookback-truncated — OpenRouter /activity only covers the last 30 completed UTC days; rows before 2026-10-26 are not available.
  • key-already-enumerated — 1 inference key(s) are also visible through a management key; their activity is read once, not twice.
  • activity-without-key — 83267287 tokens ($24.79) of activity in workspace "personal" are on no listed API key (a deleted key, or use outside one); they are reported under the workspace without a key.
  • activity-without-key — 123329506 tokens ($25.97) of activity in workspace "soilytix" are on no listed API key (a deleted key, or use outside one); they are reported under the workspace without a key.
  • no-usage-reported — OpenAI (organization "soilytix") reported no completions usage and no billed cost in this window. If you expected some, check which organization the admin key belongs to.
  • completions-only — Only completions usage is collected; embeddings, images, audio and moderation usage are not, so their billed cost appears as unattributed.
  • group-by-reduced — Anthropic rejected the full grouping; usage is split by model, api_key_id, account_id, workspace_id only.
  • local-ledger-used — 225 local row(s) come from the ledger, adding 9792559634 tokens the agent logs no longer hold (deleted or shrunk since they were recorded).
  • cost-imported — Local agent cost is ccusage’s own calculation from published unit prices, labelled `imported`. For a subscription-billed agent it is the API-equivalent of those tokens, not money billed.
  • local-overlap-removed — 697511758 local pi tokens are left out: AIUSAGE_LOCAL_BILLED_VIA says pi is billed through OpenRouter, whose rows already count them.
  • local-overlap-possible — Local agent usage is included alongside OpenRouter, OpenAI Platform, Claude Platform. Any agent billed through one of those platforms’ API keys is counted twice: ccusage cannot say which key a session used. Subscription-billed agents (Claude Max, Codex plans) do not overlap.
  • cost-allocated — openai cost is billed at a coarser grain than usage; per-model, per-key and per-account amounts are allocated from the billed totals in proportion to derived cost.
  • cost-unattributed — 0.02 USD of billed openai cost matched no collected usage (a product this tool does not collect, or usage outside the window). It is reported separately, not spread over tokens.
  • cost-allocated — anthropic cost is billed at a coarser grain than usage; per-model, per-key and per-account amounts are allocated from the billed totals in proportion to derived cost.
  • model-id-canonicalized — 12 model id(s) were merged by canonical identity — vendor prefix and pinned-snapshot date stripped, since platforms spell the same model differently: gpt-5.5 (gpt-5.5, gpt-5.5-2026-04-23, openai/gpt-5.5); gpt-6.1-sol (gpt-6.1-sol, openai/gpt-6.1-sol); claude-sonnet-5 (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-5), …. A distinct dated snapshot you needed to tell apart will read as the same row.
  • time-of-day-partial — The time-of-day statistic covers only the sources that reported sub-daily buckets. 35,749,043,246 tokens and $21674.14 come from whole-day buckets (ccusage, openrouter) and are excluded from it rather than spread across 24 hours. The report's own totals include them.

Method and provenance

Cost provenance: mixed. Reported: billed by platform. Allocated: billed coarser and split by derived cost. Imported: restated from ccusage calculation. Calculated: tokens × unit price.

Token counts are not comparable across models: cache reads and output tokens share a unit, but differ greatly in cost.

The axis shows only periods with recorded usage. Inactive periods are omitted, so horizontal spacing reflects period count rather than elapsed time.

Partially reported or absent: OpenRouter (partial), Claude Platform (partial). A missing source is unknown, not zero.

Excluded from panels: < $1 of billed cost for non-token items (web search, code execution, session fees).

Unit prices: openrouter:https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, litellm@2026-11-24.

Local agent cost is priced at today's unit prices, not those in force on the day. Rows kept in the local ledger carry the prices in force when they were recorded.

Concentration: 3% of spend fell in the single busiest day, half of it in 30 of 171 active days, and 35% in the busiest 18.
